parameters.name: BackupDbNames
parameters.description:
The databases to back up. Separate multiple databases with commas (,).
> This parameter takes effect only when the backup level is set to database level.

parameters.name: BackupLevel
parameters.description:
The backup level. Valid values:
* db: database level
* instance: instance level

parameters.name: BackupLog
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable backup logging. Valid values:
* 1: enabled
* 0: disabled

parameters.name: BackupMode
parameters.description:
The backup mode. Valid values:
* **logic**: logical backup
* **phy**: physical backup

parameters.name: DataBackupRetentionPeriod
parameters.description: The number of days for which data backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730.

parameters.name: LogBackupRetentionPeriod
parameters.description: The number of days for which log backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730. The value must be less than or equal to the data backup retention period.

parameters.name: PreferredBackupEndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the backup.

parameters.name: PreferredBackupPeriod
parameters.description:
The backup cycle. Valid values:
* 0: Monday
* 1: Tuesday
* 2: Wednesday
* 3: Thursday
* 4: Friday
* 5: Saturday
* 6: Sunday

parameters.name: PreferredBackupStartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the backup.
